adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: High plant sterols, xanthomas, hematologic abnormalities and biallelic ABCG8 variants uniquely identify sitosterolemia from failure of intestinal and hepatobiliary sterol efflux.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: NPC1L1 loss would reduce absorption, MTTP loss causes abetalipoproteinemia, NPC1 causes lysosomal cholesterol trafficking disease, and LDLR loss does not explain selective plant-sterol accumulation.
